For [core](/docs/shell/commands/categories/core/).

<div class='command-title'>Use parse-time constant from a module and export them from this module.</div>

## Command Type

`keyword`

## Signature

```> export const {flags} (const_name) (initial_value)```

## Parameters

 -  `const_name`: The constant name to create and export.
 -  `initial_value`: Equals sign followed by constant value.


## Input/output types:

| input   | output  |
| ------- | ------- |
| nothing | nothing |
## Examples

Re-export a constant from another module.
```nu
> module spam { export const foo = 3; }
    module eggs { export use spam foo }
    use eggs foo
    foo

3
```

## Notes
This command is a parser keyword. For details, check:
